title: John Paul and episode 9 as proof of an afterlife

tellings.quote: John Paul and I think through John Paul for me that was proof of afterlife

plain: A filmmaker named Ky Dickens, who made a documentary series called The Telepathy Tapes about children said to read minds, says that someone named John Paul gave her what she took as proof of an afterlife. She tells it first-hand on Michels's show, tying it to episode 9 of her series and to time spent in Atlanta, Georgia, around 2024. If true, it would mean some part of a person goes on after death.
